page_title: MON 0-1 NIC | Monaco v Nice 22/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Myron Boadu (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Takumi Minamino.
90+4' Some neat passing and movement from Monaco as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90+4' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Soungoutou Magassa walks off the pitch to be replaced by Guillermo Maripan (Monaco).
90+2' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Jordan Lotomba will be replaced by Youcef Atal (Nice).

90+1' 0 - 1 Jeremie Boga (Nice) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Philipp Kohn is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Evann Guessand (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
89' Nice take a short corner kick.

89' The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick. Aliou Balde (Nice) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Philipp Kohn makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
85' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
83' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) takes the corner which is cleared.
83' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Monaco have a corner.
83' Marcin Bulka pulls off a great save to deny Takumi Minamino (Monaco), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
82' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) replacing Caio Henrique.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Eliot Matazo (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Mohamed Camara.
81' The foul by Wilfried Singo (Monaco) was seen by Benoit Millot who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' It's a throw-in for Monaco.
80' Evann Guessand (Nice) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
78' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Gaetan Laborde and he is replaced by Aliou Balde (Nice).
78' Substitution. Evann Guessand (Nice) on for Terem Moffi.
78' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
77' Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece.
72' This is a yellow card! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
70' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
69' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
68' Caio Henrique (Monaco) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
67' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is coming onto the pitch as Folarin Balogun cannot continue after picking up an injury.

67' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Monaco can continue in their attacking effort.
64' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Morgan Sanson is replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeremie Boga (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Sofiane Diop can be given a rest.
63' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a throw-in.
56' The referee is firm and issues Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) a deserved yellow card.
55' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the centre of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Marcin Bulka who easily stops the effort.
55' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' Morgan Sanson (Nice) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Millot signals a foul. It's a penalty! Monaco have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
51' Caio Henrique (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
49' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
47' Nice keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Caio Henrique (Monaco) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+3' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+3' Vanderson (Monaco) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monaco.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The ball has crossed the sideline. Monaco are taking a throw-in.
44' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.

40' Terem Moffi (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Millot with no other option than to blow for a foul.
39' Terem Moffi (Nice) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
33' Dangerous play by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice). Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Sofiane Diop (Nice) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
32' Morgan Sanson (Nice) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
30' Sofiane Diop (Nice) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Philipp Kohn, who pulls off a comfortable save!
26' Vanderson (Monaco) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
23' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Poor challenge! Vanderson (Monaco) is penalised for tripping and Benoit Millot blows his whistle.
14' Neat passing move from Monaco in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Marcin Bulka pulls off a superb save.
11' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' The Monaco players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
10' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Monaco! Let's see what he decides.
9' Benoit Millot interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jordan Lotomba (Nice). A penalty is given to Monaco!
8' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

3' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Philipp Kohn blocks the shot with his legs.
2' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Millot.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
